2019-20 UCSC General Catalog / Courses / ITAL - Italian / Lower-Division / ITAL2

Italian
ITAL2 First-Year Italian

	During the second quarter of this first-year sequence, students learn 
to tell a story in the past, to make plans about their future, and to 
express commands and requests. The sequence starts once a year in the 
fall quarter. (Formerly Instruction in the Italian Language.)


		Requirements
	Prerequisite(s): ITAL 1 or placement by examination.


		Credits
	5


		Quarter offered
	Winter
